rag.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
rag.desc: Hybrid retrieval with Dense / Sparse / Graph channels, Weighted RRF integration, and domain-specific document indexing, with hands-on experience building RAG pipelines for aerospace documents.
rag.body:
Hybrid retrieval with Dense / Sparse / Graph channels, Weighted RRF integration, and domain-specific document indexing, with hands-on experience building RAG pipelines for aerospace documents.


## Interest


I experiment with hybrid RAG architectures that combine Dense, Sparse, and Graph retrieval and integrate them through Weighted RRF.


## Current Focus

- Domain-specific document chunking
- Retrieval quality evaluation
- Source-grounded answer generation

smartfarm-rag.name: SmartFarm RAG and Operations System
smartfarm-rag.desc: Designed and evaluated query-adaptive retrieval for RAG.
smartfarm-rag.body:
Designed and evaluated query-adaptive retrieval for RAG.


## Role and implementation


Led method design, implementation, comparative evaluation, and first-author writing.


Combined lexical, semantic, and relational retrieval signals. Used prior comparisons of retrieval combinations to replace an additional LLM call for choosing retrieval weights, and compared retrieval methods on public data.


A separate operations system connects observations, document evidence, AI explanations, operator approval, and execution-result checks.


Evidence: One related KCI journal publication


## Validation scope


The approval and execution flow was evaluated in simulation. This is not a claim of autonomous operation on a real farm. The source repository is private.

rag-evaluation.title: RAG Evaluation Notes
rag-evaluation.summary: A practical evaluation lens for comparing RAG systems across retrieval quality, answer grounding, and operating cost.
rag-evaluation.body:
A practical evaluation lens for comparing RAG systems across retrieval quality, answer grounding, and operating cost.


## Why Evaluation Comes First


If you only look at answer quality in a RAG system, it is easy to miss the cause of failure. The retrieval, reranking, and generation stages need to be separated so you can see whether documents were missed, pushed down, or ignored during answer generation.


## Basic Metrics

- Recall@5: checks whether the supporting evidence appears in the top five retrieved documents.
- MRR: measures how early the first useful evidence appears.
- Groundedness: checks whether the answer is actually supported by retrieved documents.
